name: Cake Fudge It - Choco Brownie
ingredients_raw: SUGAR, REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), REFINED PALMOLEIN OIL, EGGS, CHOCO CALLETS (10%) [SUGAR, HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE FAT, COCOA SOLIDS, EMULSIFIER (491), DEXTROSE EMULSIFIER [322(i)] & NATURAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES], MILK CHOCOLATE CHIPS (8%) [SUGAR, COCOA BUTTER, MILK SOLIDS, COCOA SOLIDS, DEXTROSE, EMULSIFIER [322(i)] & NATURAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES], COCOA SOLIDS (2%), HIGH MALTOSE SYRUP, LIQUID GLUCOSE, IODISED SALT, ARTIFICIAL (BROWNIE MAGNUM & VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, COLOUR (150d), EMULSIFIER (471), PRESERVATIVES (202 & 282), STABILIZER (415), BAKING POWDER AND ACIDITY REGULATOR (330). CONTAINS WHEAT, EGGS, MILK AND SOYA.
